spare_key.text: Do you have access to a spare key nearby?

options.label: Yes, I can get to a spare

emergency.title: Call Emergency Services Now
emergency.summary: Call 911 immediately. Many fire departments and police can unlock a vehicle quickly, and heat inside a car rises dangerously fast — this isn't a situation to wait on a locksmith for.
emergency.confidence_text: A child or pet locked inside is always treated as urgent, regardless of the weather.
not_to_do: Don't wait to see if the situation resolves on its own.
Don't leave the area looking for a locksmith instead of calling 911 first.
Don't assume mild weather makes it safe to wait — interior temperatures rise fast even on cool days.
before_help_checklist: Call 911 and describe the situation clearly.
Stay near the vehicle so you can direct responders.
If you can safely see the child or pet, keep monitoring them.

lines: I have a child (or pet) locked inside my vehicle at [location description].
The vehicle is locked and I can't get in.

emergency.next_action: Stay on the line with emergency services and follow their instructions until help arrives.

running_locked.title: Call Roadside Assistance First
running_locked.summary: An engine running with the vehicle locked isn't a 911 emergency by itself, but it should be handled promptly — roadside lockout service or a locksmith can get you back in without damaging the vehicle.
running_locked.confidence_text: This is a common, well-understood roadside call.
not_to_do: Don't attempt to force a door or window open yourself — that risks real damage.
Don't leave the vehicle running and unattended for a long period while you wait.
Don't pay a locksmith before checking if your insurance or roadside plan already covers it.
before_help_checklist: Check all doors and the trunk, just in case one is open.
Have ID or proof of ownership ready if asked.
Note your exact location for dispatch.
Stay near the vehicle if it's safe to do so.

phone_script.intro: Read this while you're on the phone with roadside assistance.
lines: Hi, I'm locked out with the engine running, at [location description].
Can you confirm ETA for lockout service?

running_locked.next_action: Consider a spare key or key fob backup so this doesn't happen again.

get_spare.title: Safe to Reassess — Get Your Spare
get_spare.summary: If a spare key is genuinely nearby and reachable, that's usually the fastest and cheapest way to get back in.
get_spare.confidence_text: This depends on how quickly and safely you can actually get to the spare — if it takes a long time or requires leaving an unsafe area, roadside service is the better call instead.
not_to_do: Don't leave the vehicle unattended somewhere unsafe just to fetch a spare.
Don't assume the spare works without testing the battery in the fob if it's electronic.
Don't forget the vehicle itself if you need someone else to bring the spare to you.
before_help_checklist: Confirm exactly where the spare is and how to get it.
Arrange safe transportation there and back if needed.
Bring ID in case you need to prove ownership somewhere.
Have a backup plan (roadside assistance) ready if the spare doesn't work.

phone_script.intro: Keep this ready in case the spare doesn't work.
lines: Hi, I'm locked out at [location description] and going to get a spare key.
Can you confirm ETA for lockout service in case I need to call back?

get_spare.next_action: If the spare doesn't work when you get back, call roadside assistance instead of trying to force entry.

roadside_lockout.title: Call Roadside Assistance First
roadside_lockout.summary: No spare available means roadside lockout service or a locksmith is the practical next step.
roadside_lockout.confidence_text: This is a textbook roadside-assistance case.
not_to_do: Don't try to force a door or window open yourself — that can cause real damage.
Don't pay for a locksmith before checking if your insurance, roadside plan, or credit card already covers it.
Don't leave valuables visible while you wait.
before_help_checklist: Check all doors and the trunk, just in case.
Have ID or proof of ownership ready if asked.
Note your exact location for dispatch.
Stay near the vehicle if it's safe to do so.

phone_script.intro: Read this while you're on the phone with roadside assistance.
lines: Hi, I'm locked out of my vehicle at [location description].
No one and nothing unsafe is inside.
Can you confirm ETA for lockout service?

roadside_lockout.next_action: Consider a spare key or key fob backup so this is a one-time issue.
